target: candidate_cash_return H3, continuous net capital-return ratio under initial-node research policy
scope: No Pyxis approval, no lower-node migration, no source requests, no production replacement
population: Fixed6050 candidate keys; fit only479 known2025H1 H3 endpoints before20250701000000; unknown retained in evaluation denominator
features: Same24 frozen continuous P features, no stage bonus, future states or old scores

pipeline.imputer: SimpleImputer median keep_empty_features=True, fitted on train only
pipeline.justification: Fixed regularized linear continuous-return baseline; alpha10 chosen before fit for shrinkage with24 features and479 rows, not validated optimum

evaluation: 2025H1 in-sample description;2025H2 sequential development validation;2026 coverage-biased stress; neither is fresh untouched holdout
ranking: Rank full daily universe before observing labels; min(5,N), deterministic code tie, no backfill. H3 primary/H5 auxiliary reuse SAME score, no H5 model
primary_comparison: 2025H2 N>5 days where all candidate cash targets known; paired mean daily top5 vs same-day pool and frozen old scores
uncertainty: 2000 circular moving-block bootstrap draws, blocks of5 ordered evaluable dates, seed20261023; exploratory95percent interval, not full-market significance or correction for missingness
research_gate: Positive mean H3 uplift vs pool AND old; lower95percent paired-uplift intervals above0 for both; daily H3 q05 no worse than both; all2025H2 top5 known-label fraction no lower than old. Every gate reported separately; no automatic deployment even if all pass
subgroups: A/SECOND attribution and monthly results, no subgroup refit or subgroup score adjustment
failure_policy: Retain single result, no retries with alternative alpha/model/threshold/samples; estimator checkpoint prevents second fit
